author: Phil Helsel
description: Nashville’s airport authority board unanimously voted Friday to begin the process to rename the city’s airport to honor late country music legend and Tennessee icon Dolly Parton.
title: Board votes to rename Nashville International Airport for Dolly Parton

author: The Politics Desk
description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.
title: Democrats shift their mail voting message: From the Politics Desk

description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani hails the unity and humanity of New Yorkers who helped one another in the aftermath of the Sept. 11 attacks 25 years ago. Mamdani spoke at the Saint Nicholas Greek Orthodox Church and National Shrine in lower Manhattan, which was completely destroyed on the day of the terror attacks.
title: Mamdani highlights the resilience and unity of New York City on 9/11 anniversary

author: Daniella Silva
description: In August alone, ICE officers and agents arrested a record-breaking 50,925 people, with the largest number of arrests taking place in Texas and Florida.
title: ICE arrests reached record highs this summer as enforcement tactics shifted

description: Welles Crowther could have escaped the World Trade Center collapse. Instead, he repeatedly ran back trying to save as many people as possible while wearing his red bandana. Now, he has been posthumously awarded the Presidential Medal of Freedom. NBC News' Aaron Gilchrist reports.
title: Honoring the man with the red bandana who saved many lives during 9/11

author: Bethany Heitman
description: Hand washing your gym clothes can help them last longer and smell fresher — but is it necessary? Two cleaning experts share when it’s worth it.
title: Should you be hand washing your workout clothes? Laundry pros explain

author: Jem Alabi
description: Following the recent robot vacuum ban, shoppers can still find deals on models from Shark, Dyson and Eufy. These robot vacuums are currently up to $450 off.
title: You can still shop these robot vacuums — and they’re up to $450 off

description: After reading names of those who lost their lives on 9/11, Michael Massaroli Jr., the son of Michael Massaroli, who lost his life in the attacks, called on others not to use the tragedy as a reason to "spread hate."
title: 9/11 victim's son says the tragedy should not be used to 'spread hate'

author: Suzanne Gamboa
description: Julie Hanway Molina, 56, is accused of diverting the funds to pay for her home mortgage, credit card bills and other personal expenses.
title: Former football booster club treasurer is accused of stealing $400K

author: Dan De Luce
description: The CIA released 71 declassified documents related to the 9/11 attacks on Friday, the 25th anniversary of deadly Al Qaeda terror attacks that killed nearly 3,000 people.
title: Previously classified 9/11 documents released by CIA on 25th anniversary of attacks

description: Ceremonies took place at the three crash sites to commemorate the nearly 3,000 lives lost in the attacks on Sept. 11, 2001. NBC News' Sam Brock reports from New York, Courtney Kube details the Pentagon ceremony and Emilie Ikeda reports from Shanksville, Pennsylvania.
title: Landmark 9/11 anniversary marked in New York, Pentagon and Shanksville ceremonies

author: Mili Godio
description: Find some of the best meal delivery services with gluten-free options. Get gluten-free meal kits from Sunbasket, Splendid Spoon, Hungryroot, Purple Carrot and more.
title: Looking for gluten-free meal delivery? Start here

author: Lisa Cavazuti
description: North Korea’s surreptitious push to plant employees in U.S. companies has expanded to include remote workers from other countries, such as Iran and Lebanon, according to U.S. government and foreign agencies and several cybersecurity researchers.
title: Now recruiting: North Korea looks abroad for talent in its scheme to infiltrate U.S. companies

description: NBC News' Monica Alba sits down with the widow of an FBI agent Jack Hess, who developed stage four cancer after responding to the Pentagon on 9/11. She shares his story and the ripple effects the attack still has 25 years later.
title: FBI agent died of cancer after 9/11 Pentagon response. His widow is now telling his story

description: Olivia Perez-Johntry was just 10 years old when she lost her father on 9/11. Now 25 years later, she has turned that loss into lessons of resiliency as a high school science teacher on Long Island, New York. She sits down with TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones to open up about how she dealt with the unimaginable loss and is using her own experience to help others.
title: Teacher Who Lost Father on 9/11 Shares Inspiring Story of Hope

author: Gary Grumbach
description: A former CIA officer who was arrested this spring with more than 303 gold bars worth $40 million in his home is working to finalize a plea deal with federal prosecutors that could help keep the case shrouded in mystery.
title: CIA officer charged in gold bars case working toward a plea deal

description: Elizabeth Holmes was a single mother working at the World Trade Center when the unthinkable happened on 9/11. Her son, Reverend Travis Boyd, is now preserving her legacy with his book “The Purse She Left Behind.” He talks about the significance of her purse, his relationship with Reverend Al Sharpton, and how he has dealt with the immeasurable loss. “My story isn’t defined by tragedy, it’s defined by the vision my mother had for me,” he says.
title: Son of 9/11 Victim Honors Mother's Legacy With New Book

description: On the 25th anniversary of 9/11, TODAY’s Al Roker honors Bill Steckman, a WNBC staffer who died along with five other radio tower engineers from other stations in the North Tower of the World Trade Center.
title: Al Roker Honors WNBC’s Bill Steckman Who Died on 9/11

author: Steve Kopack
description: President Donald Trump’s promised $5,000 “dividend” for all U.S. adults would not be paid for with taxpayer dollars, Commerce Sec. Howard Lutnick said.
title: Lutnick says Trump’s $5,000 checks for Americans wouldn’t rely on taxpayer funds

description: The U.S. Department of the Treasury has created a special half dollar to be given to the families of 9/11 victims. The coin features the Statue of Liberty and the inscription “Always Remember 9-11-01” as well as a “W” to represent West Point, where the coins were minted by New Yorkers. They will be distributed around the nation.
title: Special Coin Minted as Tribute to 9/11 Victims

description: NYPD detective Steven Stefanakos and Emergency Service Unit member Robert Zajac sit down with TODAY’s Dylan Dreyer to reflect on their experience as first responders on 9/11 and discuss how they continue to carry the story of the lives that were lost. “You can’t let it consume you, but it’s always there,” Zajac says.
title: NYPD First Responders Reflect on 9/11 and Carrying the Story

description: TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones reflect on the 25th anniversary of 9/11. Sheinelle looks back on working her job as a morning reporter and Jenna recalls her sister Barbara’s story about her Secret Service agent and his young daughter.
title: Jenna Bush Hager Shares 9/11 Story About Secret Service Agent

description: NBC’s chief Washington correspondent Andrea Mitchell and Ron Insana, who was working as a CNBC anchor and reporter on Sept. 11, join TODAY’s Savannah Guthrie to look back on their experience reporting as the terrorist attacks unfolded.
title: NBC’s Andrea Mitchell Recalls Reporting on 9/11

description: NBC’s Anne Thompson joins TODAY’s Savannah Guthrie and recounts being in lower Manhattan 25 years ago on 9/11 to report on the attacks. Anne recalls evading the collapsed building, witnessing countless acts of heroism and breaks down the health impacts many people are suffering in the years since the disaster.
title: NBC’s Anne Thompson Recounts Disaster and Heroism on 9/11

description: President Trump, speaking at the Pentagon, paid tribute to the passengers aboard United Airlines Flight 93 who fought back against the hijackers, forcing the terrorists to crash the plane into a field in Pennsylvania.
title: Trump recalls acts of heroism aboard United 93 at Pentagon 9/11 ceremony

description: Francesca Picerno and Jay Winuk, who both lost family members on 9/11, join TODAY’s Craig Melvin to mark the 25th anniversary, share the importance of the 9/11 Day organization and open up about their work to educate younger generations about the tragedy.
title: Passing the Torch of 9/11 Remembrance to Younger Generations

author: Monica Alba
description: An FBI agent who responded to the Pentagon on 9/11 later died from cancer. His wife is telling their story.
title: FBI agent died of cancer after 9/11 Pentagon response. His widow tells his story.

author: Rebecca Shabad
description: Indiana’s Supreme Court ruled after a months-long recount that a Republican incumbent state senator narrowly defeated his Trump-backed challenger in the GOP primary for the state Senate seat.
title: Indiana Supreme Court rules for state senator over Trump-backed candidate in GOP primary recount

author: Ashley Morris
description: Colored mascaras have been on our feeds all summer, but are they really safe to use on your eyes? I asked ophthalmologists to find out about the potential risks and how to avoid them.
title: Colored mascara has taken over my Instagram feed — but is it safe for your eyes?

description: Trinh K. Dinh, Paramedic, FDNY reflects on September 11, 2001, and shows the tattoo she got as a reminder of her work that day.
title: First responder’s tattoo

description: Former FDNY paramedic Roger Smyth shares his photographs taken on September 11, and reflects on partnering with FDNY paramedic Trinh K. Dinh, to care for survivors after both got separated from their regular partners. He also captured the moments Trinh and her partner, Ronnie Coyne, reunited after Ronnie was thought to be lost in the collapse at Ground Zero. Roger’s partner also survived the chaos at Ground Zero.
title: September 11 through the lens of a paramedic

author: Mili Godio
description: Heat, sweat and humidity during heated workouts may damage your hair and scalp. Here’s how dermatologists recommend prepping your hair before and after.
title: Is hot yoga ruining your hair? Here’s what dermatologists say

description: Former WNBC New York cameraman Ralph Patterson shares the moment his family must have realized he was down near the World Trade Center on September 11, 2001.
title: Cameraman shares his experience working near the scene on 9/11

author: Steve Kopack
description: Friday’s August inflation report could mark a pivotal moment for interest rates, affordability and Kevin Warsh, President Donald Trump’s new Fed chairman.
title: August inflation report could set the path for interest rates, affordability

author: Michelle Garcia
description: From an 11-year-old watching the towers fall on a classroom TV to a doctor treating victims in a conference room, NBC News readers share their searing memories from Sept. 11, 2001.
title: ‘Never Forget’: How Americans remember Sept. 11

author: Steve Kopack
description: “We are endangering one of the strongest economic pillars that we have in this country,” said fourth-generation Iowa farmer Mark Mueller.
title: Diesel hits all-time high of $6 per gallon and just about everything will cost more

author: Amanda Terkel
description: Aside from mentions by Trump and top administration officials, speakers at the convention mostly avoided talking about the war.
title: Republicans largely ignore the war in Iran at their midterm convention

author: Henry J. Gomez
description: The vice president drew on the birth of his fourth child and the one-year anniversary of Charlie Kirk’s death in his GOP midterm convention speech.
title: Vance positions himself as a fighter for family values and a ‘national birthright’

description: Dramatic video captures the rescue of a 15-year-old boy found alive after clinging to a boat for days. He and two others were on a fishing trip when their boat capsized in the Bering Sea. NBC News’ Steven Romo spoke to his family.
title: Teen rescued after days stranded in the waters off Alaska

description: NBC News’ Tom Llamas reports for the series “The Cost of Denial” about the emerging health crisis 25 years after the attacks of 9/11, the first responders now being diagnosed with dementia. Researchers believe the condition is connected to exposure to toxins at Ground Zero, but dementia is not one of the conditions covered by the World Trade Center Health Program.
title: 9/11 first responders push for coverage of dementia
